story: After multiple attacks, a leading trio of Dries de Bondt, Jarno Bellens, and Samuel Flórez formed. The race was briefly paused due to road damage. The breakaway was caught on the local lap. Several further attacks were neutralized, with Jordi Meeus winning the final sprint ahead of Foldager.
